facts.fact: 落地后 Adam 判断三人身处 spirit realm（灵界）
facts.anchor: “I think we’re in the spirit realm,” Adam said.

facts.fact: Jack 听不出猎人们的语言：它与 Elvish 相似但并不是，他需要更多语料才能解析
facts.anchor: “I don’t know it. It’s similar to Elvish, but not. I’d need a lot more to work with.”

facts.fact: Adam 半回头时发现一支箭射在 Jack 的胸口
facts.anchor: Adam half turned to see an arrow sticking from Jack’s chest.

facts.fact: Two 名猎人倒在 Daff 脚下——皮肤布满疼痛的痘疮、口吐白沫
facts.anchor: Two of the other hunters lay at her feet. Their skin was covered in painful-looking pox. They foamed at the mouth.

facts.fact: 战败的猎人首领折断了自己鹿角的尖端（Adam 本以为又要开打）
facts.anchor: Adam braced for another fight, but the hunter broke off the tip of his antler.

facts.fact: Jack 判定他们的跳跃被劫持出自 higher magic，且不是那些猎人所为——对方和他们一样困惑
facts.anchor: “I don’t know, but it was higher magic. I don’t think it was whatever they were. They seemed as confused as us.”

facts.fact: Jack 揭示：the Between 是一座监狱，而且只关押一个存在（one being, and only one）
facts.anchor: It’s a prison for one being, and only one.

facts.fact: Jack 揭晓：她是他们的创造者——造了他们、他们的世界、Alfheimr，还有 the Between
facts.anchor: “She’s their creator. She made them, and their world. She made Alfheimr. The Between too.”
